Thanks for pulling this together. A few executive priorities to bake into the slide deck (we need one high-level page and a backup appendix):

1) Risk & mitigation single slide: we need a concise "top 3 risks" with clear mitigation owners and one-line residual impact. Example rows: Capacity surge impact -> mitigation: Dedicated reserved + burst policy (owner: Marissa) -> residual: <10% revenue exposure.
2) Sales ask: Marissa, include a short sensitivity table showing how 10% higher token usage vs forecast affects gross margin for Nimbus. Keep it two lines — execs do not want the workbook in the slide.
3) Security: Karthik / Lauren, confirm whether the two Nimbus procurement flags are block or informational. If they are blockers, call out timeline to remediate; we will need to authorize a procurement exception if it delays deployment into Dedicated.
4) Ops readiness: Ben/Engineering, provide an ETA for the failover drill and a single tested failover play that we can present.

Please put the one-slide draft in the Drive link and mark the rows in the action log as either "on track" or "at risk". I'll review the slide Friday morning and flag anything I want added to the backup appendix.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Operations — Redwood Inference
